notes.confirmed: Boe-Bot chassis; Arduino Mega; feedback on wheel and gimbal actuators; portrait Pixel 5, rear cameras forward at pan zero.
notes.estimated: 1 mph top speed is the owner's estimate, not a measurement. Wheel dimensions, torque, acceleration, FOV and all gimbal limits are provisional.
notes.pan: 0..pi is a simulation design target for a half-turn to show the screen. It does not establish the physical gimbal travel.
notes.geometry: Mechanical dimensions and masses are defined in HomeBot.proto. Update them alongside these controller parameters; run smoke tests after changes.
